description: Ministry of Technology - Amended the Electronic Transactions (e - Population Register) Regulations No. 1 of 2014
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made under the Electronic Transactions Act, No. 19 of 2006, specifically amending the Electronic Transactions (e-Population Register) Regulations. It deals with legal/regulatory matters concerning electronic signatures and certified copies/extracts from electronic records of births and deaths, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
